events.description: Father's care needs become urgent; placed on the LTC waiting list with Orchard Villa listed
events.quote: In 2019, my family and I found that my father’s care was becoming urgent

events.description: Father accepted into and moves into Orchard Villa
events.quote:
In November 
2019 my father was accepted in to the home within days

events.description: Father is a victim of staff-to-resident abuse in his first month; complaint to the Director of Care
events.quote:
During the first month of my father’s stay at the home, he was the victim of staff-to-resident
abuse

events.description: Father hospitalized with acute kidney failure from dehydration
events.quote:
he was in acute kidney 
failure due to lack of hydration

events.description: Specialist appointment at Lakeridge Health: melanoma progression stopped
events.quote: In January, 2020 my father and I attended a meeting with one of his medical specialists

events.description: Orchard Villa goes into lockdown
events.quote: After Orchard Villa went in to lockdown on March 14, 2020

events.description: COVID-19 reported at Pinecrest long-term care home in Bobcaygeon
events.quote:
On March 19, 2020 a media report stated that COVID-19 had been detected at the 
Pinecrest long-term care home

events.description: Father's voice very weak on Parkes's birthday call; RN says fever too low for a test
events.quote:
On April 11, 2020 I was celebrating my 
birthday and called my father

events.description: Brother reaches father by phone but he cannot speak
events.quote: April 12, 2020 my oldest brother was the only person able to reach my father

events.description: Parkes asks for a COVID-19 test, family access and oxygen; Director of Care says home is well staffed; oxygen refused
events.quote:
On 
Monday, April 13, 2020 I tried calling my father several times

events.description: Parkes sees her unresponsive father through his window; request to send him to hospital denied
events.quote: On April 14, 2020, unable to reach my father by phone

events.description: Father dies at Orchard Villa
events.quote: At 12:00 p.m. on April 15, 2020 I received a phone call

events.description: Lakeridge Health staff sent into Orchard Villa
events.quote:
staff 
members of Lakeridge Health were not sent in to the home until April 22, 2020

events.description: Canadian Armed Forces enter Orchard Villa; later military report names it among the five worst homes
events.quote:
The Canadian 
Armed Forces also entered the home on April 28, 2020

events.description: Father's funeral limited to ten family members
events.quote: My father’s funeral was limited to ten family members

events.description: Families of Orchard Villa testify before the Long-Term Care COVID-19 Commission
events.quote:
we 
did participate by speaking with the commissioners for a full day on October 23, 2020

events.description: Parkes emails the MLTC opposing Southbridge's 87 extra beds and 30-year licence extension
events.quote: On June 25, 2021, I submitted an email to the MLTC

events.description: MLTC public teleconference consultation on the Southbridge proposal; speakers limited and lines jammed
events.quote:
I attended MLTC’s 
public teleconference consultation on July 15, 2021

events.description: Ministry notice of a further consultation after Southbridge's corporate restructuring
events.quote: In the Fall of 2022, a notice posted the Ministry’s website

events.description: Parkes makes a written submission to the second consultation
events.quote: a copy of my October 17, 2022 email submission

events.description: Parkes learns the Director's approval of the Southbridge proposal was posted
events.quote:
In December 2023, I learned from Natalie Mehra that notice of the 
Director’s decision

Director's decision approving the Southbridge proposal
